title: Director Factory of the Future
text:
**Company Description**

**About AbbVie**

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**

The Director, Factory of the Future, leads AbbVie’s global strategy, design standards, and delivery of next-generation factories and manufacturing operations that leverage Industry 4.0/5.0, robotics, automation, and AI. The Director owns the Factory of the Future vision and roadmap across biotechnology, aseptic manufacturing, packaging, medical device, and chemical production, and leads a team of senior engineers and technical leaders who develop reference designs, run pilots, and enable deployment into new facilities and major site transformations. This role partners with Operations leadership, Engineering, Quality, PDS&T, Supply Chain, BTS, and Security to ensure future factories are safe, compliant, flexible, and highly automated, and deliver measurable gains in quality, speed, and cost.

**Vision and Strategy**

* **Factory of the Future strategy:** Define and own the multi-year Factory of the Future vision, technology roadmap, and investment case, aligned to Operations, network, and enterprise AI and digital strategies.
* **Network and capital alignment:** Partner with Global Engineering, Manufacturing, and Finance to embed future-factory design principles and technology choices into the capital plan, site master plans, and new-facility business cases.

**Design and Technology Leadership**

* **Reference designs and standards:** Establish global reference designs, design standards, and technology platforms for aseptic and biologics manufacturing, packaging, device assembly, and chemical production, including modular, flexible, and continuous concepts.
* **Automation, robotics, and AI:** Direct the evaluation, piloting, and scale-up of robotics, autonomous material handling, vision inspection, digital twins, advanced process control, and AI-enabled operations, in partnership with BTS and Operations AI.
* **Technical governance:** Provide design authority and review for major capital projects; ensure cGMP, Annex 1, data integrity, device regulations, EHS, and OT/IT cybersecurity requirements are built in from concept stage.

**Delivery and Value**

* **Portfolio delivery:** Lead a portfolio of Factory of the Future pilots, proofs of concept, and project deployments, managing scope, schedule, budget, risk, and benefits.
* **Value tracking:** Define KPIs (e.g., OEE, right-first-time, labor productivity, cycle time, capex efficiency, sustainability) and report realized value to the Operations Leadership Team.

**Leadership and Ecosystem**

* **Team leadership:** Build, lead, and develop a global team of principal and senior principal engineers and technical specialists; create a pipeline of future-factory talent.
* **External engagement:** Develop strategic relationships with equipment OEMs, automation integrators, technology startups, academia, and industry bodies (e.g., ISPE) to benchmark and access emerging capabilities.
* **Executive communication:** Represent Factory of the Future in executive and enterprise forums, translating technical concepts into business outcomes.

 
**Qualifications** 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Biomedical, Electrical, Automation, Industrial, or related) required; Master’s, PhD, or MBA preferred.
* Minimum of 18 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device manufacturing, engineering, or technology, including 8+ years leading teams and large capital or technology programs.
* Proven record of leading greenfield/brownfield facility design or major site transformations from concept through startup.
* Expertise in aseptic and sterile manufacturing and/or biologics; experience across packaging, device, or chemical production is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated leadership in deploying Industry 4.0/5.0 technologies (robotics, automation, MES/MOM, IIoT, digital twins, AI/ML) at scale in GMP environments.
* Strong command of cGMP, Annex 1, data integrity, computer system assurance, and OT/IT cybersecurity expectations.
* Ability to build business cases and manage multi-million-dollar budgets and portfolios.
* Executive presence and ability to influence senior leaders across a global matrix organization.
* Experience developing and leading high-performing technical teams, including senior technical talent.
* Professional certifications (PE, PMP, ISPE CPIP) and a record of external publications, patents, or industry leadership are a plus.

 
**Additional Information**

Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law:

* The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future.
* We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.
* This job is eligible to participate in our long-term incentive programs.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.
